image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ installed in a stone archway, likely within a church or cathedral. The instrument features multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, housed in a reddish-brown wooden case with decorative carvings and moldings. The central section has taller pipes flanked by shorter ones, creating a symmetrical stepped silhouette. Lower sections show additional pipe arrays behind wooden grilles. The surrounding architecture includes Gothic-style stone columns and arches.
